faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does MedsZop verify my prescription?
faq.a1: Every uploaded prescription is reviewed and validated by a licensed pharmacist registered with the state pharmacy council prior to order confirmation.
faq.q2: Are all medicines sourced from genuine pharmacies?
faq.a2: Yes. MedsZop exclusively partners with licensed retail pharmacies adhering strictly to the Drugs & Cosmetics Act standards.
faq.q3: Can I order prescription-only (Schedule H / H1) medicines without a prescription?
faq.a3: No. Under Indian pharmaceutical law, Schedule H and H1 medications strictly require a valid prescription from a registered medical practitioner.
faq.q4: What should I do if I need to cancel my order?
faq.a4: You can cancel your order from the My Orders dashboard at any time before the pharmacy packages the items for delivery dispatch.
